# NVIDIA NVTX headers

Unmodified C API headers, their transitive dependencies, and license from NVIDIA NVTX v3.3.0-c-cpp,
commit `7c1f2d47f153dac7a0703b162f4b2eaa0ac47c83`:
https://github.com/NVIDIA/NVTX/tree/7c1f2d47f153dac7a0703b162f4b2eaa0ac47c83

License: Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions; see LICENSE.txt.
Only the separate profiling executables include these headers. Ordinary
benchmark executables do not use NVTX. No network fetch or installed NVTX
shared library is needed to compile or run the CPU profiling checks.
